senses.gloss: c. (φορφύρα, purpura) purple, esp. purple cloak, royal garment.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:12">Cant. R. to IV, 12</cite> (expl. <cite ref="T01045"><he>רקמה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Ezekiel 16:10">Ez. XVI, 10</cite>) <he>פ׳</he> purple garments; Pesik. B’shall., p. 84ᵇ <he>פורפירון</he>; Lam. R. beg. (some ed. <cite ref="Q00382"><he>פורפריא</he></cite>). Ib. <he>מבזע פ׳ שלו</he> he rends his purple cloak (in mourning); ib. to II, 17 <he>בזע פּוּרְפִּירֵיה</he> (some ed. <he>פורפירין</he>, corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="B00459"><he>בְּזע</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30">Ex. R. s. 30</cite> <he>גינו בפ׳ שהוא לבוש</he> (not <he>בפורפרא</he>) they criticised the cloak he wore.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7">Deut. R. s. 7</cite> <he>לְבוֹשׁ פ׳ שלי</he> put on my royal cloak.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:10">Esth. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>פ׳ דמלכא מזדבנא וכ׳</he> the royal purple is sold, woe to him who sells, woe to him who buys it; <he>כך ישראל הן פ׳ שהק״בה מתפאר בהן</he> (some ed. <cite ref="Q00382"><he>פורפריא</he></cite>) so Israel is the purple cloak, for the Lord is glorified through them; a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="Q01965"><he>פּוּרְפְּרָאוֹת</he></cite>.
